incident.scope: An earlier native-consent test used an ineffective worker interception in the test harness and let a real provider upload complete. The synthetic fixture was already public in the repository. This is retained as a test-isolation incident, not an intercepted test or an independent remote-file verification.
incident.remediation: Stopped the test, disclosed the event, and used a verified fail-closed HTTP/CONNECT proxy with direct fallback disabled before subsequent consent clicks. Native Deny created no job/copy; Allow copied locally but the provider connection was blocked. No second provider upload occurred.

limitations: Firefox ZIP temporarily installed, not Mozilla-signed or AMO-approved.
Firefox does not expose the Chrome tab-capture/Cast APIs used here; codecs depend on the browser and OS.
Physical receiver playback, real provider parity, all public sites and the whole E2E corpus are not certified by these checks.
